headlines.title: 'Nothing has gotten better': Focus group shares affordability concerns as US debt tops $40 trillion
headlines.description: NBC News' Allie Canal and Sahil Kapur join Meet the Press NOW as the U.S. national debt tops a record-breaking $40 trillion. Ravi Agrawal, editor in chief of Foreign Policy, discusses President Trump's plans for an "Economic D-Day" for Iran. An NBC News focus group produced by Syracuse University and the research firms Engagious and Sago finds that affordability remains the top issue for voters ahead of November's midterm elections.

headlines.title: ‘Rearranging deckchairs on the Titanic’: Bonds erase the impact of Treasury’s intervention
headlines.description: Bond yields jumped Thursday, erasing the declines stemming from the Treasury Department’s unusual intervention in the debt market a day earlier.

headlines.title: Woman accused of plotting ISIS-inspired attack on New York Capitol building
headlines.description: A woman has been charged with providing support to a terror group after allegedly plotting an ISIS-inspired attack on the New York State Capitol building in Albany, federal officials said. NBC News' Tom Winter reports.

headlines.title: DEA to Join Investigation Into Hayden Panettiere’s Death
headlines.description: As officials try to understand what happened in Hayden Panettiere’s final moments, the Drug Enforcement Agency is now working with local authorities on the investigation, according to a source familiar with the probe. It comes as her untimely death is prompting fellow actors to discuss the intense pressure young stars face in Hollywood. NBC’s Kaylee Hartung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Royal U-Turn: Prince Harry and His Family to Move Back to UK
headlines.description: Six years after moving to California for a new life, Prince Harry and Meghan Markle, along with their two children, are now preparing to move back to the United Kingdom. The duke and duchess of Sussex will reportedly keep their home in Montecito but make the UK their primary base, with Archie and Lilibet enrolled in British schools starting in September. NBC’s Daniele Hamamdjian reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: FBI searches Eric Swalwell's home and seizes his electronic devices
headlines.description: The FBI has raided former Rep. Eric Swalwell's home and seized his electronic devices, according to a person familiar with the matter. NBC News' Gary Grumbach reports on the search and allegations of sexual misconduct the former congressman is facing.

headlines.title: Surrogate who had baby in Texas against parents’ wishes denies ‘political theater’ accusation
headlines.description: McKenna West, the surrogate in the center of a multi-state legal battle over a baby who was born with a rare heart condition, sought to “set the record straight.”

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: She devoted her career to helping police families. Now she’s a suspect after her officer husband’s death.
headlines.description: Federal agencies have joined the third day of a search for Karen Solomon, a longtime police mental health advocate whose husband was found dead.

headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: 16-year-old girl runs on field and tackles football player mid-game, is charged with assault
headlines.description: Video of the incident shows the girl coming out of nowhere to level the middle school player, then shove him to the ground as he tried to get up.
